result.title: DiffusionRVGE: Reinforcement Learning via Regression-Based Value Gradient Estimation
result.summary: Reinforcement learning improves diffusion models using rewards on generated images, but repeated denoising and gradient estimation make training expensive. We introduce \method, an efficient method that constructs useful update directions by regressing centered rewards on centered final denoised images. It requires neither reward derivatives nor adjoint backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. A unified first-variation formulation identifies the value-gradient target with or without a trajectory-KL penalty. A population analysis under Gaussian noising explains the regression geometry, while a subspace analysis motivates clean-image coordinates. The implementation adapts rollout bandwidth and query weights to reward continuity: local rollouts suit smooth rewards, whereas broader groups provide informative contrasts for discrete rewards. Trained jointly on five rewards, one SD3.5-Medium model matches or exceeds DiffusionNFT's joint model on seven of eight metrics, reaching GenEval $0.94$, OCR $0.92$, and PickScore $23.82$ at about one fifth of its estimated training compute. In single-reward training, \method reaches matched reward thresholds $2.1$--$6.7\times$ faster than reproduced DiffusionNFT on identical hardware. Ablations support the clean-image estimator, direct direction transfer, and reward-dependent rollout choices. Code is available at https://github.com/jy-wang-tsinghua/DIFFUSIONRVGE.

AI.brief_summary: 针对扩散模型用奖励微调时反复去噪与梯度估计开销大的问题，提出 DiffusionRVGE：以中心化奖励对中心化最终去噪图像做回归来构造更新方向，无需奖励导数，也无需对采样轨迹做伴随反向传播，并分析其回归几何与干净图像坐标选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用回归估计价值梯度、避免贯穿整条采样轨迹反传」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多步 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配与低成本训练监督提供可核查线索；但该文面向图像生成的奖励优化，与 VLM 推理状态的关联仍需自行判断。
